start_command: cd backend && export DATABASE_PATH=./eval-e.db JWT_SECRET=eval-secret-at-least-32-bytes-long-0123456789 PROVIDER_TIMEZONE=UTC APP_ENV=dev && rm -f eval-e.db && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn telemed.api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 > ../eval-e-server.log 2>&1
start_note: Backend :8000 only (API-only group, no frontend). DATABASE_PATH is relative to backend/, so sqlite3 inspection targets backend/eval-e.db. JWT_SECRET must be exported (min 32 bytes). No admin bootstrap endpoint: insert an admin via sqlite3 (argon2 hash from uv run python, same technique as groups C/D), log in via POST /api/auth/login. Doctors are created via POST /api/admin/doctors (E2-S2), which also generates 14 days of slots; use at least 3 doctors (A, B, C) with differing specialty (e.g. Cardiology vs Dermatology), languages (e.g. [hi,en] vs [en]), fee (e.g. 300.00, 500.00, 750.00) and full_name. Patients register via POST /api/auth/register. Booking (POST /api/appointments, E3-S2) does NOT exist yet: to put a slot in BOOKED state with an appointment (F040) the evaluator sets slots.status='BOOKED' and inserts an appointments row (plus a BOOKED event if the schema requires one) directly via sqlite3, then re-reads both after the call. Past slots (F047) and day-specific states (F044) are also arranged via sqlite3 UPDATEs on slots.start_time/status. Doctor deactivation uses the admin deactivate route if mounted, else sqlite3 UPDATE users SET active=0 on a doctor with no live appointments.

api_checks.note: setup/regression: GET /health -> 200; onboard doctors A, B, C via POST /api/admin/doctors (201, slots_created > 0); login each; register patient P and login. Failure blocks the group.
doctor A and doctor B both have slots. Login as A, GET with from=now (ISO, tz-aware, URL-encoded) and to=now+7d.

expect_body_fields.items: non-empty array of Slot {slot_id:int, doctor_id:int, start_time:ISO datetime, end_time:ISO datetime, status in AVAILABLE|BOOKED|BLOCKED}
expect_body_fields.items[*].doctor_id: all equal A's user_id (none equal B's)

api_checks.note: range filtering and status visibility: after one slot is BLOCKED (E-API-2a) and one set BOOKED via sqlite, list again; blocked/booked slots appear with their actual status. A narrow from/to window returns only slots whose start_time lies inside it. No from/to defaults to now..now+14d. to < from -> 422; range > 31 days -> 422.
pick an AVAILABLE slot S1 of doctor A, PUT block with no body, then confirm via sqlite3 (SELECT status FROM slots WHERE slot_id=S1) and via the E-API-1a listing.
blocking an already BLOCKED slot is rejected and changes nothing (single conditional UPDATE, no state corruption).

slot S2 of doctor A set BOOKED with an appointment (status BOOKED) via sqlite3. Snapshot slot row and appointment row, PUT block as A, expect 409, then re-read: slot status still BOOKED, appointment status still BOOKED, appointment.slot_id unchanged, no new appointment_events rows.
S1 is BLOCKED (from E-API-2a). PUT unblock as A; verify via sqlite3 that status is AVAILABLE.
unblock a non-BLOCKED slot: once on the now-AVAILABLE S1 and once on the BOOKED S2. Both 409, rows unchanged.

doctor A PUTs block (then unblock) on an AVAILABLE slot owned by doctor B. Slot id exists, so 404 (not 403/409) proves ownership is hidden. Verify via sqlite3 that B's slot is still AVAILABLE. Also 404 for a nonexistent slot id (e.g. 999999).
patient P calls block, unblock and GET /api/doctors/me/slots -> 403 each; admin also 403 (permission matrix); no token on block/unblock -> 401. Slot row unchanged.

as patient P: GET ?specialty=Cardiology returns only doctors whose specialty is Cardiology (and includes A); case-insensitive (?specialty=cardiology gives same set); unknown specialty returns items [] total 0.

expect_body_fields.items: array of DoctorSummary {doctor_id, full_name, specialty, languages[], fee, earliest_slot}

api_checks.note: ?language=hi returns only doctors whose languages contain hi (case-insensitive, ?language=HI same); doctors speaking only en are absent. Combined ?specialty=Cardiology&language=hi is the intersection.

make doctor A's slots on a chosen future day D (within 14d) all BLOCKED or BOOKED (via PUT block and sqlite3), while doctor B keeps open slots on D. GET with available_from=D 00:00Z and available_to=D 23:59Z: A absent, B present. A wider range containing another open day returns A again.
validation per API-09: available_to < available_from -> 422; naive (no tz) datetime -> 422 VALIDATION_ERROR.

three requests with sort=earliest_slot (also the default when omitted), sort=fee, sort=name. earliest_slot: nondecreasing, nulls last; fee: nondecreasing compared numerically as Decimal (300.00, 500.00, 750.00, not string order); name: alphabetical ascending (case-insensitive). Ties broken by name then doctor_id. sort=bogus -> 422.

every item has fee matching ^\d+\.\d{2}$ and is a JSON string (not number); earliest_slot is an ISO datetime equal to the min start_time of that doctor's AVAILABLE slots in (now, now+14d) (cross-check with sqlite3), or null when none. Items expose only DoctorSummary fields (no password_hash, email).
deactivate doctor C (admin deactivate route or sqlite3 active=0). GET /api/doctors never lists C, with or without filters; GET /api/doctors/{C}/slots -> 404 and GET /api/doctors/{C} -> 404.

for doctor A arrange via sqlite3: one AVAILABLE slot now+2h, one BOOKED, one BLOCKED, one AVAILABLE slot 1h in the past, one AVAILABLE slot at now+15d. GET as patient P: only AVAILABLE slots with now < start_time < now+14d are returned, ordered ascending by start_time, every item status AVAILABLE; the BOOKED, BLOCKED, past and +15d slots are absent by slot_id.
unknown doctor id (999999) -> 404; a user id that belongs to a patient (not a doctor) -> 404 (API-11).
no Authorization header; also an invalid/garbage bearer token -> 401.

no Authorization header on GET /api/doctors/{A}/slots, GET /api/doctors/{A} and GET /api/doctors/me/slots -> 401 each; garbage bearer -> 401. Route-ordering (contract section 4): GET /api/doctors/me/slots with a patient token returns 403 (not 404/422 from /{doctor_id} parsing "me" as int).

access-rule order (api-contracts 0.2.1: 404 before 409): set doctor B's slot BOOKED via sqlite3; doctor A PUTs block and unblock on it -> 404 (not 409); doctor B's slot and appointment unchanged. Also doctor A unblock on B's BLOCKED slot -> 404, slot still BLOCKED.
permission matrix: doctor token and admin token each call GET /api/doctors, GET /api/doctors/{A}/slots -> 200 (any authenticated role).
GET /api/doctors response shape: total equals len(items); items[*] contain exactly DoctorSummary fields and doctor_id, specialty, languages[] match the onboarding values for A and B.

content_rules: E2-S3 AC2/AC3/AC4: block and unblock are each a single conditional UPDATE in slots_repo.py (AVAILABLE->BLOCKED with doctor_id = caller; BLOCKED->AVAILABLE), checking rowcount; no read-then-write status check in doctor_service
E2-S3 AC5: foreign or absent slot id yields 404 (not 403/409); service/repository scope by doctor_id = caller; INVALID_SLOT_STATE (409) is raised for non-AVAILABLE block and non-BLOCKED unblock
E2-S3 AC5/auth: /api/doctors/me/* guarded by require_roles(DOCTOR) (403 for patient and admin); literal /me routes are registered BEFORE /{doctor_id} routes in routers/doctors.py
E2-S3 AC1: GET /me/slots accepts query aliases from and to, tz-aware datetimes, default from=now, to=from+14d, to>=from and range <=31 days else 422

E2-S4 AC1/AC2/AC3: filter and sort logic lives in doctors_repo.py (specialty and language case-insensitive, availability EXISTS over AVAILABLE slots in [from,to], sort in earliest_slot|fee|name with nulls last and ties by name then doctor_id); sort is an enum rejected with 422 when invalid; no filtering or sorting done in the router

E2-S4 AC4: fee serialised as a 2-decimal string through types/money.py (never float); DoctorSummary has earliest_slot (datetime or null); queries filter active users only so deactivated doctors never appear
E2-S4 AC5: open-slots query uses status = AVAILABLE AND start_time > now AND start_time < now + 14 days ordered by start_time
E2-S4 AC6: all /api/doctors endpoints depend on the authenticated-user dependency (401 without a valid token)

review_notes: Final contract reviewed by evaluator against stories E2-S3, E2-S4 and specs/design/api-contracts.md (API-09..API-14, 0.2.1 matrix, route ordering).

Removed: files_must_exist entries for integration test files, files_must_not_exist for routers/appointments.py, the Layering content rule, and the injected-clock clause of the AC5 rule. None traces to an acceptance criterion or the API contract.
Added: E-API-5c (404-before-409 ordering, AC5 + matrix), E-API-10c (doctor/admin may read doctors and slots), E-API-9c (DoctorSummary shape and values, AC4). Tightened E-API-5b, E-API-10b, E-API-11b.
Kept as contract-derived (API-12 to API-14): default range, to<from and >31d 422 in E-API-1b; INVALID_SLOT_STATE code on 409.
Booking endpoints (E3-S2) do not exist yet, so BOOKED states are arranged via sqlite3. Block-vs-booking concurrency is out of scope (E3-S2).
API-10 (GET /api/doctors/{id}) is supporting, spot-checked in E-API-9b and E-API-11b.
